protocol: transductive clustering on all X; y is evaluation only
implementation: educational NumPy; not an exact paper reproduction
loss_scaling: reconstruction averages N*D; KL and k-means distortion average N
sane_scope: IDEC adaptation of ICLR 2026 DACHI/DSS; original ResNet/MoCo-v2 code was not run

DEC.paper_title: Unsupervised Deep Embedding for Clustering Analysis
DEC.mechanism: Student-t soft assignments, sharpened target P, KL optimization
DEC.implementation_scope: Independent NumPy adaptation; small shared AE and Digits, not original experiment

IDEC.paper_title: Improved Deep Embedded Clustering with Local Structure Preservation
IDEC.mechanism: DEC KL objective plus reconstruction to preserve local structure
IDEC.implementation_scope: Independent NumPy adaptation of the user's target; architecture, pretraining and data differ
IDEC.experiment_role: target paper and paired comparison baseline

DECRA.paper_title: Deep Embedding Clustering Based on Residual Autoencoder
DECRA.mechanism: Adaptive latent linear branch and decoder consistency, following released code
DECRA.implementation_scope: DECRA code-inspired adaptation with common plain-AE pretraining; released code differs from residual addition in paper Eq. 5

DCSS.paper_title: Deep Clustering Using the Soft Silhouette Score: Towards Compact and Well-Separated Clusters
DCSS.mechanism: Learnable Gaussian RBF assignment head, soft-silhouette objective, entropy penalty
DCSS.implementation_scope: Released-code objective and RBF adapted to the shared NumPy AE; original backbone, training budget and pretraining differ; code omits probability-mass normalization of paper Eq. 13
DCSS.experiment_role: 2026 candidate selected for compatibility with the DEC/IDEC/DECRA family; not established SOTA

initialization_protocol: Within each seed all methods clone identical plain-AE pretrained weights and initial KMeans centers; SANE then applies DACHI; DECRA adds randomly initialized adaptive branch
selection_protocol: Literature-led exploratory candidates, fixed settings before five-seed run; highest Digits mean is not universal 2025/2026 SOTA
decra_scope: Released-code loss on shared NumPy backbone; no residual-AE pretraining; KL mean averages N*K unlike IDEC N
dcss_scope: Released-code soft silhouette + RBF + entropy on shared backbone; source normalization and temperature differ from paper equations
timing_definition: standalone = pretrain + shared KMeans initialization + method fitting including epoch loss traces; excludes final external metrics, plots and file writes
